The Journey
journey.desc_1: Since 2014, The Watch Collections has curated high-end timepieces from the world’s most prestigious brands, including Richard Mille, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, Rolex, Cartier, and more.
journey.desc_2:
We offer an in-store service in Jakarta, ensuring that every timepiece we present is authentic, safe, and trustworthy.
Inspired by the art and craftsmanship of fine watches, we are committed to helping you find the perfect piece with honesty, respect, and ethical service.
